issue: `DoogatError::Parse` changed on REST and NoSQL from redacted `INTERNAL_ERROR`/500 to `PARSE_ERROR`/422 with the raw message. The PRD says "no HTTP status changes on any code" and gives only 409/404/500 as category defaults, so the 422 for PARSE_ERROR is not in the spec. REST and NoSQL now also expose parse text, which can echo stored-file content that REST previously hid. The change is disclosed in CHANGELOG.md:22 and the table row is at ddb-core/src/app_contract/error.rs:77-82.
reason: requirements ambiguity (PRD says no status changes; the unified policy implies two). Both changes are deliberate, documented in CHANGELOG.md, errors.md and server.md, and pinned by tests. Reverting is a public-contract decision for the maintainer, not a rework fix; deferred to batch end.
